title: DR1 labels the file question "Attachment"; the frontend labels it "Upload a file".

finding.frontend: The third question is labelled "Upload a file", in bold like the two questions above it (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/copy/copy.en.js:11-16).
finding.prototype: DR1 labels the same question "Attachment", matching the name the field carries in its markup and the wording of its error, "Upload a document" (app/views/upload-documents.html:154-158).
finding.difference: Change the label to "Attachment" in the English and Welsh copy files. It is one string, but it is the noun the rest of DR1's documents copy is built around — the error message and the field name both use it — so leaving it as a verb phrase keeps the frontend's error wording out of step too.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the frontend rendering "Attachment" as the label of its file field.

relatedTo.why: the field's error wording is built on the same noun
